title: How long
html_source:
“How long is Haines going to stay in this tower?”: Stephen views Haines not as a visiting English scholar rooming with Mulligan and him, but as an invading force occupying his home. For Stephen, Haines is a individual token of the larger, uninvited, unwelcome British military presence in Ireland, an occupied Ireland that Stephen sees represented in his and Mulligan’s tower digs. “How long?” Stephen wonders. How long indeed?

The contemporary occupation of Ireland/the Martello tower finds ancient correspondence in the occupation of Penelope’s home by the unwelcome suitors, who move in and refuse to be dislodged for the duration of Odysseus’s absence.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: @emquegee This is great, if it’s worth saying so a year on …
